<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>STUDYVERSE — Learn. Compete. Grow.</title>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>

:root{--bg:#f4f7fc;--card:#fff;--ink:#13203b;--muted:#64748b;--line:#e2e8f0;--navy:#14264a;--blue:#4f46e5;--blue-soft:#eef2ff;--violet:#7c3aed;--mint:#10b981;--mint-bg:#ecfdf5;--amber:#f59e0b;--amber-bg:#fffbeb;--shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(19,32,59,.06);--shadow-lg:0 18px 40px rgba(79,70,229,.14)}

*{box-sizing:border-box}

body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 "Plus Jakarta Sans",Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}

button{cursor:pointer;border:0;transition:all .2s ease}

.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:268px 1fr;min-height:100vh}

aside{background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px 14px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;z-index:40}

aside::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}

aside::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#cbd5e1;border-radius:10px}

.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 10px 18px;font-weight:800;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.3px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:10px}

.brand-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}

.logo{height:38px;width:38px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--violet));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(79,70,229,.3)}

.close-drawer{display:none;background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:800}

.navlabel{font-size:10px;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.3px;padding:14px 12px 6px;text-transform:uppercase}

.nav button{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;background:transparent;color:#475569;margin:2px 0;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}

.nav button.active,.nav button:hover{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue)}

.nav .ico{width:22px;text-align:center;font-size:16px}

.sidebottom{margin-top:auto;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f5f7ff,#eef2ff);border:1px solid #e0e7ff;border-radius:15px;padding:14px;font-size:12px;color:#475569}

main{padding:24px 32px 54px;max-width:1440px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;min-width:0}

.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);flex-wrap:wrap}

.top-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}

.menu-toggle{display:none;background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;font-size:19px;font-weight:800}

.eyebrow{color:var(--blue);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase}

.top h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:2px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.4px}

.profile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.mini-timer-pill{display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border:1px solid #fde68a;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}

.mini-timer-pill.running{display:inline-flex}

.avatar{height:40px;width:40px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e0e7ff,#ede9fe);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;border:2px solid #c7d2fe}

.btn-login-pill{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--violet));color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}

.page{display:none}.page.active{display:block;animation:svFade .24s ease}

@keyframes svFade{from{opacity:.6;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

.sectionhead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:28px 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.sectionhead h3{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.3px}

.sub,.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}

.grid{display:grid;gap:16px}.two{grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr}.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}

.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}

.card:hover{border-color:#cbd5e1;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(19,32,59,.08)}

.hero-banner{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#0f172a 0%,#3730a3 52%,#7c3aed 100%);color:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:30px 32px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.hero-banner::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;right:-60px;top:-80px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.16),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}

.hero-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.7px}

.hero-banner h2{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,34px);line-height:1.18;margin:14px 0 10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.6px}

.hero-banner p{color:#e0e7ff;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:560px}

.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.primary{background:#fff;color:#3730a3;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px}

.primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}

.secondary-hero{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}

.secondary-hero:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.26)}

.stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}

.staticon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef2ff,#f3e8ff);flex-shrink:0}

.stat strong{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15}

.stat small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}

.tile{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}

.tileicon{height:46px;min-width:46px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef2ff,#f3e8ff);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px}

.tile h4,.tile h3{margin:0 0 4px}.tile p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}

.action{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid #dbeafe;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:11px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-decoration:none}

.action:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(79,70,229,.22)}

.action.outline{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}

.action.outline:hover{background:#f8fafc;color:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue)}

.progress{height:8px;background:#e2e8f0;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}

.progress span{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--violet));border-radius:999px;transition:width .35s ease}

.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue)}

.tag.mint{background:var(--mint-bg);color:#047857}.tag.amber{background:var(--amber-bg);color:#b45309}

.field,input,select,textarea{padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;width:100%;margin:6px 0 12px;color:var(--ink)}

.field:focus,input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,.14);outline:none}

textarea.field{min-height:92px;resize:vertical}

.quote{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffbeb,#fef3c7);border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}

.quote b{color:#b45309;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.8px}.quote p{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0;color:#78350f}.quote small{color:#92400e}

.listitem{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:10px}

.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.rank{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.rank:last-child{border:0}

.ranknum{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800}

.rankname{flex:1}.rankname b{display:block}.score{font-weight:800;color:var(--blue)}

.quizopt{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;margin:8px 0;font-weight:600}

.quizopt:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-soft)}

.search-bar-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}.search-bar-row input{flex:1;min-width:220px;margin:0}

.breadcrumb-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

.chapter-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}

.chapter-num{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-soft);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;width:fit-content}

.timer-shell{text-align:center;padding:26px 20px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,#f5f7ff)}

.timer-modes{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}

.timer-mode-btn{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}

.timer-mode-btn.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}

.timer-clock{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,68px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-2px;color:var(--navy);margin:10px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

.timer-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}

.flashcard-box{min-height:220px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e1b4b,#4338ca);color:#fff;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);user-select:none;transition:transform .2s ease}

.flashcard-box:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.flashcard-box.flipped{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#065f46,#0d9488)}

.goal-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#f8fafc}

.goal-item.done span{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--muted)}

.admin-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px;padding:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px}

.admin-tab-btn{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:13px}

.admin-tab-btn.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}

.admin-panel-group{display:none}.admin-panel-group.active{display:grid;gap:18px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(310px,1fr))}

.divider{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:16px 0}

.toast{position:fixed;bottom:22px;right:22px;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);display:none;z-index:9999999;font-weight:600;max-width:340px}

#authBox{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;margin:auto!important;width:calc(100% - 32px)!important;max-width:440px!important;height:max-content!important;max-height:calc(100vh - 32px)!important;overflow-y:auto!important;z-index:999999!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;border-radius:22px!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;padding:26px!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 100vmax rgba(15,23,42,.78),0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important}

.drawer-backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.5);z-index:35}.drawer-backdrop.show{display:block}

@media(max-width:1024px){.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

@media(max-width:900px){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}aside{position:fixed;left:-290px;top:0;bottom:0;width:270px;transition:left .25s ease;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(15,23,42,.25)}aside.open{left:0}.menu-toggle,.close-drawer{display:grid;place-items:center}main{padding:16px 16px 40px}}

@media(max-width:560px){.three,.four{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-banner{padding:22px}.top{padding:12px 14px}.profile .who{display:none}}

</style>

</head>

<body>

 

<div class="drawer-backdrop" id="drawerBackdrop" onclick="toggleMobileSidebar(false)"></div>

 

<div class="layout">

  <aside id="sidebar">

    <div class="brand">

      <div class="brand-left"><div class="logo">S</div><span>STUDYVERSE</span></div>

      <button class="close-drawer" onclick="toggleMobileSidebar(false)" aria-label="Close menu">✕</button>

    </div>

 

    <div class="navlabel">LEARNING SPACE</div>

    <nav class="nav">

      <button class="active" data-page="home"><span class="ico">⌂</span>Dashboard</button>

      <button data-page="classes"><span class="ico">🎓</span>All Courses &amp; Chapters</button>

      <button data-page="materials"><span class="ico">📚</span>Study Materials &amp; PDFs</button>

      <button data-page="studentvideos"><span class="ico">🎥</span>Video Lectures</button>

      <button data-page="practice"><span class="ico">✎</span>Daily Practice</button>

      <button data-page="studentquiz"><span class="ico">🧠</span>Quiz Challenge</button>

      <button data-page="mocktestportal"><span class="ico">📝</span>Mock Tests</button>

      <button data-page="flashcards"><span class="ico">⚡</span>Flashcards &amp; Formulas</button>

    </nav>

 

    <div class="navlabel">PRODUCTIVITY &amp; HELP</div>

    <nav class="nav">

      <button data-page="studytracker"><span class="ico">⏱️</span>Study Timer &amp; Tracker</button>

      <button data-page="studyplanner"><span class="ico">📅</span>Study Planner</button>

      <button data-page="assignments"><span class="ico">📑</span>Assignments</button>

      <button data-page="studentdoubts"><span class="ico">💬</span>Doubt Solver</button>

      <button data-page="games"><span class="ico">♟</span>Brain Games</button>

    </nav>

 

    <div class="navlabel">COMMUNITY &amp; UPDATES</div>

    <nav class="nav">

      <button data-page="leaderboard"><span class="ico">♛</span>Leaderboard</button>

      <button data-page="studentrewards"><span class="ico">🏆</span>My Rewards &amp; XP</button>

      <button data-page="community"><span class="ico">◎</span>Study Community</button>

      <button data-page="updates"><span class="ico">📢</span>Exam Updates</button>

      <button data-page="studentnotifications"><span class="ico">🔔</span>Notifications</button>

    </nav>

 

    <div class="navlabel">YOUR SPACE</div>

    <nav class="nav">

      <button data-page="progress"><span class="ico">↗</span>My Progress</button>

      <button data-page="myprofile"><span class="ico">👤</span>My Profile</button>

      <button data-page="motivation"><span class="ico">✦</span>Motivation</button>

      <button id="adminNavBtn" data-page="admin" style="display:none;"><span class="ico">🛡️</span>Admin Panel</button>

    </nav>

 

    <div class="sidebottom"><b>Studyverse Promise</b><br>Every course, every learner, one focused platform.</div>

  </aside>

 

  <main>

    <div class="top">

      <div class="top-left">

        <button class="menu-toggle" onclick="toggleMobileSidebar(true)" aria-label="Open menu">☰</button>

        <div>

          <div class="eyebrow">YOUR LEARNING UNIVERSE</div>

          <h1 id="pageTitle">Welcome, Learner 👋</h1>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="profile">

        <div id="miniTimerPill" class="mini-timer-pill" onclick="showPage('studytracker')" title="Open Study Timer">

          <span>⏱️</span><span id="miniTimerText">25:00</span>

        </div>

        <select id="lang" class="field" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:8px 10px">

          <option value="en">EN</option>

          <option value="hi">हिंदी</option>

        </select>

        <button id="openAuthBtn" class="btn-login-pill" onclick="openAuthModal()">Login / Sign Up</button>

        <div class="avatar" id="studentAvatar">S</div>

        <div class="who">

          <b id="studentName">Student</b>

          <div class="sub" id="studentClass">Select your course</div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

 

    <!-- HOME DASHBOARD -->

    <section id="home" class="page active">

      <div class="hero-banner">

        <div style="flex:1;min-width:250px;position:relative;z-index:1">

          <span class="hero-pill">✦ STUDYVERSE ALL-IN-ONE LEARNING HUB</span>

          <h2 id="heroGreeting">Master every subject, track your focus &amp; crack your dream exam 🚀</h2>

          <p>School classes, JEE, NEET, UPSC, CUET, SSC, Coding &amp; Skill courses — notes, video lectures, mock tests, focus timer, flashcards and live rankings all in one place.</p>

          <div class="hero-btns">

            <button class="primary" onclick="showPage('classes')">Explore All Courses →</button>

            <button class="secondary-hero" onclick="showPage('studytracker')">⏱️ Start Focus Timer</button>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div style="font-size:clamp(56px,8vw,86px);text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1">🎓📚</div>

      </div>

 

      <div class="grid four" style="margin-top:20px">

        <div class="card stat"><div class="staticon">⚡</div><div><strong id="dashboardXP">0</strong><small>My Learning XP</small></div></div>

        <div class="card stat"><div class="staticon">📝</div><div><strong id="dashboardQuizCount">0</strong><small>Quizzes Completed</small></div></div>

        <div class="card stat"><div class="staticon">🎯</div><div><strong id="dashboardAccuracy">—</strong><small>Quiz Accuracy</small></div></div>

        <div class="card stat"><div class="staticon">��</div><div><strong id="dashboardRank">—</strong><small>Leaderboard Rank</small></div></div>

      </div>

 

      <div class="grid two" style="margin-top:22px">

        <div class="card">

          <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:12px"><h3 style="margin:0">📖 Continue Your Learning</h3><span class="tag">Recommended</span></div>

          <div class="tile">

            <div class="tileicon">⚛️</div>

            <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">

              <h4>Explore Courses &amp; Chapter Syllabus</h4>

              <p>Pick your track (Class 5–12, JEE, NEET, UPSC, Coding, SSC, CA) and study chapter-wise.</p>

              <div class="progress"><span style="width:65%"></span></div>

              <small class="muted">12+ learning tracks · 200+ chapters organized</small>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px">

            <button class="action" onclick="showPage('classes')">Open Courses →</button>

            <button class="action outline" onclick="showPage('practice')">Quick Practice</button>

          </div>

        </div>

 

        <div class="card">

          <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:10px"><h3 style="margin:0">✅ Today's Study Goals</h3><span id="goalCountBadge" class="tag mint">0/0 Done</span></div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">

            <input id="newGoalInput" class="field" style="margin:0" placeholder="Add a study goal (e.g. Solve 20 PYQs)">

            <button class="action" style="margin:0;white-space:nowrap" onclick="addStudyGoal()">+ Add</button>

          </div>

          <div id="dailyGoalsList"></div>

        </div>

      </div>

 

      <div class="sectionhead"><h3>🚀 Quick Access Portals</h3><span class="sub">Everything a serious student needs</span></div>

      <div class="grid four">

        <div class="card"><h3>🎓 Courses &amp; Chapters</h3><p class="muted">School, Competitive &amp; Coding tracks</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('classes')">Explore Tracks</button></div>

        <div class="card"><h3>📚 Study Materials</h3><p class="muted">Chapter PDFs, notes &amp; sheets</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('materials')">Open Materials</button></div>

        <div class="card"><h3>🎥 Video Lectures</h3><p class="muted">Concept-wise video lessons</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('studentvideos')">Watch Lectures</button></div>

        <div class="card"><h3>📝 Mock Tests</h3><p class="muted">Timed exam-pattern tests</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('mocktestportal')">Start Tests</button></div>

        <div class="card"><h3>⏱️ Focus Study Timer</h3><p class="muted">Pomodoro clock &amp; daily streak</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('studytracker')">Open Timer</button></div>

  <button onclick="closeAuthModal()" style="width:100%;padding:10px;margin-top:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:13px">Continue Browsing Platform →</button>

  <p id="authMessage" role="status" class="sub" style="margin-top:10px;font-weight:600"></p>

</div>

 

<script>

const titles={home:"Welcome, Learner 👋",classes:"All Courses, Classes & Exams",materials:"Study Materials & PDFs",practice:"Daily Practice Zone",studentquiz:"Quiz Challenge",studentvideos:"Video Lecture Portal",studentdoubts:"Doubt Solving Portal",mocktestportal:"Mock Test Portal",flashcards:"Flashcards & Formula Hub",games:"Study & Brain Games",leaderboard:"Student Leaderboard",studentrewards:"My Rewards & Badges",studentnotifications:"Notifications & Updates",assignments:"My Assignments",studyplanner:"Study Planner & Schedule",studytracker:"Focus Study Timer & Tracker",community:"Study Community",updates:"Exam Updates & Calendar",myprofile:"My Profile",progress:"My Learning Progress",motivation:"Motivation Corner",admin:"STUDYVERSE Admin Panel"};

function toggleMobileSidebar(show){const s=document.getElementById("sidebar"),b=document.getElementById("drawerBackdrop");if(!s||!b)return;s.classList.toggle("open",show);b.classList.toggle("show",show)}

function openAuthModal(){document.getElementById("authBox").style.display="block"}

function closeAuthModal(){document.getElementById("authBox").style.display="none"}

function showPage(id,saveHistory=true){

  const t=document.getElementById(id);if(!t)return;

  const c=document.querySelector(".page.active");

  if(saveHistory&&c&&c.id!==id){pageHistory.push(c.id);try{window.history.pushState({page:id},"","#"+id)}catch(e){}}

  document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));t.classList.add("active");

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x.dataset.page===id));

  const te=document.getElementById("pageTitle");

  if(te){if(id==="home"){const h=new Date().getHours(),g=h<12?"Good morning":h<17?"Good afternoon":"Good evening",sn=document.getElementById("studentName")?.textContent||"Learner";te.textContent=`${g}, ${sn} 👋`}else{te.textContent=titles[id]||"STUDYVERSE"}}

  toggleMobileSidebar(false);window.scrollTo(0,0);

  if(typeof db!=="undefined"){

    if(id==="home"){loadDashboardXP();updateDashboardStats()}

    if(id==="classes")loadStudentCoursePortal();

    if(id==="materials")loadStudentMaterialsPortal();

    if(id==="leaderboard"){loadLeaderboard();loadStudentLeaderboard()}

    if(id==="assignments")loadStudentAssignments();

    if(id==="studyplanner")loadStudentStudyEvents();

    if(id==="studytracker")loadStudyTracker();

    if(id==="studentnotifications")loadStudentNotifications();

    if(id==="studentrewards")loadMyRewards();

    if(id==="studentvideos")loadStudentVideoLectures();

    if(id==="mocktestportal")loadStudentTests();

    if(id==="studentdoubts")loadMyDoubts();

    if(id==="progress")syncProgressPage();

  }

}

function goBackPage(){const p=pageHistory.pop();if(p)showPage(p,false)}

window.addEventListener("popstate",goBackPage);

document.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>showPage(b.dataset.page)));

function notify(s){const t=document.getElementById("toast");t.textContent=s;t.style.display="block";clearTimeout(window._toastTimer);window._toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.style.display="none",3000)}

function switchAdminTab(gId,btn){document.querySelectorAll(".admin-panel-group").forEach(g=>g.classList.remove("active"));document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));document.getElementById(gId)?.classList.add("active");btn?.classList.add("active")}

};

 

function renderTrackCards(filterText="",category="all"){

  const grid=document.getElementById("trackGrid"),q=filterText.trim().toLowerCase();

  const filtered=tracks.map((t,idx)=>({t,idx})).filter(({t})=>{

    if(category!=="all"&&t[3]!==category)return false;

    if(!q)return true;

    const subs=trackSubjects[t[0]]||[];

    return t[0].toLowerCase().includes(q)||t[1].toLowerCase().includes(q)||subs.some(s=>s.toLowerCase().includes(q));

  });

  if(!filtered.length){grid.innerHTML=`<div class="card" style="grid-column:1/-1"><p class="muted" style="margin:0">No matching course tracks found.</p></div>`;return}

  grid.innerHTML=filtered.map(({t,idx})=>`<div class="card tile"><div class="tileicon">${t[2]}</div><div style="flex:1"><div class="row"><h3 style="margin:0">${t[0]}</h3><span class="tag">${(trackSubjects[t[0]]||[]).length} Subjects</span></div><p class="sub" style="margin:6px 0 0">${t[1]}</p><button class="action" onclick="openTrack(${idx})">Open Track →</button></div></div>`).join("");

}

 

function filterTracksAndChapters(){

  const q=(document.getElementById("courseSearchInput")?.value||"").trim().toLowerCase(),cat=document.getElementById("trackCategoryFilter")?.value||"all";

  renderTrackCards(q,cat);

  const qb=document.getElementById("quickSearchResults");

  if(!q||q.length<2){qb.style.display="none";qb.innerHTML="";return}

  const matches=[];

  Object.entries(subjectChapters).forEach(([subject,chs])=>chs.forEach(ch=>{if(ch.toLowerCase().includes(q)||subject.toLowerCase().includes(q))matches.push({subject,ch})}));

  if(matches.length){

    qb.style.display="block";

    qb.innerHTML=`<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700">Matching Chapters (${Math.min(matches.length,8)} shown):</div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">${matches.slice(0,8).map(m=>`<button class="action outline" style="margin:0;font-size:12px" onclick="openChapter('${m.subject.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}','${m.ch.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')">${m.subject}: ${m.ch}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;

  }else qb.style.display="none";

}

 

function backToTracks(){document.getElementById("trackDetailPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel").style.display="none"}

function backToSubjects(){document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("trackDetailPanel").style.display="block"}

function backToChapters(){document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel").style.display="block"}

 

function openTrack(index){

  currentTrackIndex=index;const track=tracks[index],panel=document.getElementById("trackDetailPanel"),title=document.getElementById("trackDetailTitle"),list=document.getElementById("trackSubjectList");

  document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel").style.display="none";

  panel.style.display="block";title.textContent=track[0]+" — Subjects";

  list.innerHTML=(trackSubjects[track[0]]||[]).map(s=>`<div class="card chapter-card"><div><span class="chapter-num">${(subjectChapters[s]||[]).length||3} Chapters</span><h3 style="margin:8px 0 4px">${s}</h3><p class="sub" style="margin:0">Notes, Lectures, Quizzes &amp; PYQs</p></div><button class="action" onclick="openSubject('${s.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')">Open Subject →</button></div>`).join("");

  panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});

}

 

function openSubject(subject){

  currentSubjectName=subject;const panel=document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel"),title=document.getElementById("chapterDetailTitle"),list=document.getElementById("chapterList");

  document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel").style.display="none";panel.style.display="block";title.textContent=subject+" — Complete Chapters";

  const chapters=subjectChapters[subject]||["Chapter 1: Fundamentals","Chapter 2: Core Concepts","Chapter 3: Practice & Applications"];

  list.innerHTML=chapters.map((ch,idx)=>`<div class="card chapter-card"><div><span class="chapter-num">Chapter ${idx+1}</span><h4 style="margin:8px 0 0">${ch}</h4></div><button class="action" onclick="openChapter('${subject.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}','${ch.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')">Study Chapter →</button></div>`).join("");

  panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});

}

 

async function openChapter(subject,chapter){

  const panel=document.getElementById("chapterContentPanel");currentSubjectName=subject;

  document.getElementById("trackDetailPanel").style.display="none";document.getElementById("chapterDetailPanel").style.display="none";

  document.getElementById("chapterContentTitle").textContent=subject+" — "+chapter;

  if(typeof loadChapterMaterials==="function")loadChapterMaterials(subject,chapter);

  loadChapterExtraResources(subject,chapter);

  panel.style.display="block";panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});

}

 

async function loadChapterExtraResources(subject,chapter){

  const vBox=document.getElementById("chapterVideos"),qBox=document.getElementById("chapterQuiz"),pBox=document.getElementById("chapterPYQ"),tBox=document.getElementById("chapterTest"),lBox=document.getElementById("chapterLinks");

  lBox.innerHTML=`<p class="sub">Trusted resources for <b>${chapter}</b>:</p><a class="action outline" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(subject+" "+chapter+" notes pdf")}">Search Notes PDF ↗</a><a class="action outline" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${encodeURIComponent(subject+" "+chapter+" one shot lecture")}">YouTube One-Shot ↗</a>`;

  if(typeof db==="undefined")return;

  vBox.textContent="Loading video lectures...";

  const {data:vids}=await db.from("study_video_lectures").select("title,video_url,description").eq("is_published",true).ilike("subject",`%${subject}%`).limit(5);

  vBox.innerHTML=(vids&&vids.length)?vids.map(v=>`<div class="listitem"><b>${v.title}</b><p class="sub">${v.description||""}</p><a href="${v.video_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="action">Watch Video ↗</a></div>`).join(""):`<p class="muted">No uploaded videos for ${subject} yet.</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('studentvideos')">Browse All Lectures</button>`;

  const {data:qd}=await db.from("quiz_questions").select("id").eq("is_published",true).ilike("subject",`%${subject}%`);

  qBox.innerHTML=`<p class="muted">${(qd&&qd.length)?qd.length+" questions available in "+subject:"Practice questions from Studyverse quiz bank."}</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('studentquiz')">Start Quiz Challenge →</button>`;

  const {data:pyqs}=await db.from("study_pyqs").select("question,exam_name,exam_year").eq("is_published",true).ilike("subject",`%${subject}%`).limit(3);

  pBox.innerHTML=(pyqs&&pyqs.length)?pyqs.map(p=>`<div class="listitem"><span class="tag">${p.exam_name} ${p.exam_year}</span><p style="margin:6px 0 0">${p.question}</p></div>`).join(""):`<p class="muted">No PYQs uploaded for ${subject} yet.</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('practice')">Daily Practice →</button>`;

  const {data:tests}=await db.from("study_tests").select("title,duration_minutes").eq("is_published",true).ilike("subject",`%${subject}%`).limit(3);

  tBox.innerHTML=(tests&&tests.length)?tests.map(t=>`<div class="listitem"><b>${t.title}</b><div class="sub">${t.duration_minutes} mins</div></div>`).join("")+`<button class="action" onclick="showPage('mocktestportal')">Go to Mock Tests</button>`:`<p class="muted">Attempt full mock tests in the Mock Test Portal.</p><button class="action" onclick="showPage('mocktestportal')">Open Mock Tests →</button>`;

}

 

const qs=[

  {q:"A body starts from rest and moves with uniform acceleration. Which equation gives its velocity after time t?",o:["v = u + at","s = ut + ½at²","v² = u² + 2as","F = ma"],a:0,e:"For uniform acceleration, final velocity v = u + at."},

  {q:"The SI unit of force is:",o:["Joule","Newton","Watt","Pascal"],a:1,e:"Force is measured in newtons (N)."},

  {q:"Which data structure works on the LIFO (Last In, First Out) principle?",o:["Queue","Stack","Linked List","Binary Tree"],a:1,e:"A Stack removes the most recently added element first (LIFO)."},

  {q:"Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Equality?",o:["Articles 14–18","Articles 19–22","Articles 23–24","Article 32"],a:0,e:"Articles 14 to 18 cover the Right to Equality."},

  {q:"What is the pH value of pure neutral water at 25°C?",o:["0","5","7","14"],a:2,e:"Neutral solutions have a pH of 7 at 25°C."}

];

let qi=0,totalCorrect=0,totalAttempted=0;

function renderQ(){const q=qs[qi];document.getElementById("qtext").textContent=q.q;document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="";document.getElementById("opts").innerHTML=q.o.map((x,i)=>`<button class="quizopt" onclick="answer(${i})">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${x}</button>`).join("")}

function updateQuizStats(){const acc=totalAttempted?Math.round((totalCorrect/totalAttempted)*100):0;document.getElementById("quizStats").textContent=`Attempted: ${totalAttempted} | Correct: ${totalCorrect} | Accuracy: ${acc}%`}

async function answer(i){

  const q=qs[qi],isCorrect=(i===q.a);

  const {data:{user},error:userError}=await db.auth.getUser();

  if(userError||!user){document.getElementById("feedback").textContent=(isCorrect?"Correct! ✓ ":"Not quite. ")+q.e+" (Login to save score)";}

  else{

    const {error}=await db.from("quiz_attempts").insert({user_id:user.id,question_id:"q"+(qi+1),is_correct:isCorrect});

    if(error){document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="Score save error: "+error.message;return}

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent=(isCorrect?"Correct! ✓ ":"Not quite. ")+q.e;

  }

  totalAttempted++;if(isCorrect)totalCorrect++;updateQuizStats();

  document.querySelectorAll(".quizopt").forEach((b,j)=>{b.disabled=true;if(j===q.a)b.style.borderColor="#10b981"});

}

function nextQ(){qi=(qi+1)%qs.length;renderQ()}

 

/* FOCUS TIMER */

let focusTotalSeconds=1500,focusRemainingSeconds=1500,focusInterval=null,focusModeName="Pomodoro Focus";

function formatMMSS(sec){return String(Math.floor(sec/60)).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(sec%60).padStart(2,"0")}

function updateTimerDisplay(){const f=formatMMSS(focusRemainingSeconds);document.getElementById("focusTimerDisplay").textContent=f;document.getElementById("miniTimerText").textContent=f;const pct=focusTotalSeconds>0?((focusTotalSeconds-focusRemainingSeconds)/focusTotalSeconds)*100:0;document.getElementById("timerProgressBar").style.width=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,pct))+"%"}

function setTimerMode(m,label,btn){pauseFocusTimer();focusTotalSeconds=m*60;focusRemainingSeconds=focusTotalSeconds;focusModeName=label;document.getElementById("timerModeLabel").textContent=label.toUpperCase();document.querySelectorAll(".timer-mode-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));btn?.classList.add("active");updateTimerDisplay()}

function applyCustomTimer(){const m=Number(document.getElementById("customTimerMinutes").value);if(!m||m<1||m>180)return;pauseFocusTimer();focusTotalSeconds=m*60;focusRemainingSeconds=focusTotalSeconds;focusModeName=`Custom ${m}m`;document.getElementById("timerModeLabel").textContent=`CUSTOM STUDY (${m} MIN)`;document.querySelectorAll(".timer-mode-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));updateTimerDisplay()}

function playTimerChime(){try{const ctx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();[523.25,659.25,783.99].forEach((freq,i)=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type="sine";o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.15,ctx.currentTime+i*.16);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,ctx.currentTime+i*.16+.35);o.connect(g);g.connect(ctx.destination);o.start(ctx.currentTime+i*.16);o.stop(ctx.currentTime+i*.16+.36)})}catch(e){}}

function startFocusTimer(){if(focusInterval)return;document.getElementById("miniTimerPill")?.classList.add("running");document.getElementById("timerStartBtn").textContent="⏳ Running...";focusInterval=setInterval(()=>{if(focusRemainingSeconds>0){focusRemainingSeconds--;updateTimerDisplay()}else{pauseFocusTimer();playTimerChime();const c=Number(localStorage.getItem("sv_sessions_today")||0)+1;localStorage.setItem("sv_sessions_today",c);document.getElementById("todayFocusSessions").textContent=c;notify(`🎉 ${focusModeName} complete!`);const mi=document.getElementById("studyMinutes");if(mi)mi.value=Number(mi.value||0)+Math.round(focusTotalSeconds/60)}},1000)}

function pauseFocusTimer(){if(focusInterval){clearInterval(focusInterval);focusInterval=null}document.getElementById("timerStartBtn").textContent="▶ Start Focus";if(focusRemainingSeconds===focusTotalSeconds||focusRemainingSeconds===0)document.getElementById("miniTimerPill")?.classList.remove("running")}

function resetFocusTimer(){pauseFocusTimer();focusRemainingSeconds=focusTotalSeconds;document.getElementById("miniTimerPill")?.classList.remove("running");updateTimerDisplay()}

function logFocusSessionToTracker(){const mins=Math.max(1,Math.round((focusTotalSeconds-focusRemainingSeconds)/60)),sub=document.getElementById("timerSubjectTag")?.value||"Study",mi=document.getElementById("studyMinutes"),ni=document.getElementById("studyNote");if(mi)mi.value=Number(mi.value||0)+mins;if(ni&&!ni.value.includes(sub))ni.value=(ni.value?ni.value+", ":"")+`${sub} (${mins}m)`;notify(`Added ${mins} mins (${sub}). Click "Save Today's Progress" to sync!`)}

 

/* GOALS, SCRATCHPAD & FLASHCARDS */

function loadStudyGoals(){const list=document.getElementById("dailyGoalsList"),badge=document.getElementById("goalCountBadge");if(!list)return;let g=[];try{g=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("sv_daily_goals")||"[]")}catch(e){}if(!g.length){g=[{text:"Complete 1 Pomodoro Focus Session (25m)",done:false},{text:"Attempt 10 Practice / PYQ Questions",done:false}];localStorage.setItem("sv_daily_goals",JSON.stringify(g))}badge.textContent=`${g.filter(x=>x.done).length}/${g.length} Done`;list.innerHTML=g.map((x,i)=>`<div class="goal-item ${x.done?"done":""}"><label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;flex:1;margin:0"><input type="checkbox" style="width:auto;margin:0" ${x.done?"checked":""} onchange="toggleStudyGoal(${i})"><span>${x.text}</span></label><button onclick="deleteStudyGoal(${i})" style="background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:700">✕</button></div>`).join("")}

function addStudyGoal(){const inp=document.getElementById("newGoalInput"),t=(inp?.value||"").trim();if(!t)return;const g=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("sv_daily_goals")||"[]");g.unshift({text:t,done:false});localStorage.setItem("sv_daily_goals",JSON.stringify(g));inp.value="";loadStudyGoals()}

function toggleStudyGoal(i){const g=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("sv_daily_goals")||"[]");if(g[i])g[i].done=!g[i].done;localStorage.setItem("sv_daily_goals",JSON.stringify(g));loadStudyGoals()}

function deleteStudyGoal(i){const g=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("sv_daily_goals")||"[]");g.splice(i,1);localStorage.setItem("sv_daily_goals",JSON.stringify(g));loadStudyGoals()}

function saveScratchpad(){localStorage.setItem("sv_scratchpad",document.getElementById("quickScratchpad")?.value||"");document.getElementById("scratchpadStatus").textContent="Saved ✓ ("+new Date().toLocaleTimeString()+")"}

function clearScratchpad(){if(!confirm("Clear your local quick notes?"))return;localStorage.removeItem("sv_scratchpad");document.getElementById("quickScratchpad").value=""}

 

const flashcardBank=[

  {cat:"Physics",front:"Newton's Second Law & Impulse",back:"F = dp/dt = ma  |  Impulse J = F·Δt = Δp"},

  {cat:"Physics",front:"Lens Maker's Formula",back:"1/f = (μ - 1)(1/R₁ - 1/R₂)"},

  {cat:"Physics",front:"Einstein's Photoelectric Equation",back:"K_max = hν - φ₀"},

  {cat:"Chemistry",front:"Ideal Gas Equation",back:"PV = nRT  (R = 8.314 J/mol·K)"},

  {cat:"Chemistry",front:"Nernst Equation (298 K)",back:"E = E° - (0.0591 / n) log₁₀ Q"},

  {cat:"Maths",front:"Quadratic Formula",back:"x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a"},

  {cat:"Maths",front:"Integration by Parts (ILATE)",back:"∫u·v dx = u∫v dx - ∫(u' · ∫v dx) dx"},

  {cat:"Biology",front:"Powerhouse vs Protein Factory",back:"Mitochondria = ATP | Ribosomes = Protein Synthesis"},

  {cat:"Biology",front:"Central Dogma of Biology",back:"DNA → mRNA → Protein"},

  {cat:"Coding",front:"Binary Search Time Complexity",back:"O(log n) on sorted arrays"},

  {cat:"Coding",front:"ACID Properties in SQL",back:"Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability"},

  {cat:"GK",front:"Article 32 of Indian Constitution",back:"Right to Constitutional Remedies"}

];

let activeDeck=[...flashcardBank],flashIdx=0,flashFlipped=false;

function loadFlashcardDeck(){const cat=document.getElementById("flashcardCategory")?.value||"all";activeDeck=cat==="all"?[...flashcardBank]:flashcardBank.filter(c=>c.cat===cat);flashIdx=0;flashFlipped=false;renderFlashcard()}

function renderFlashcard(){if(!activeDeck.length)return;const c=activeDeck[flashIdx],b=document.getElementById("flashcardBox");b.classList.toggle("flipped",flashFlipped);document.getElementById("flashcardSubjectBadge").textContent=c.cat.toUpperCase()+(flashFlipped?" · ANSWER":" · CONCEPT");document.getElementById("flashcardText").textContent=flashFlipped?c.back:c.front;document.getElementById("flashcardHint").textContent=flashFlipped?"Tap to see question ↻":"Tap card to reveal answer ↻";document.getElementById("flashcardCounter").textContent=`Card ${flashIdx+1} / ${activeDeck.length}`}

function flipFlashcard(){flashFlipped=!flashFlipped;renderFlashcard()}

function nextFlashcard(){flashIdx=(flashIdx+1)%activeDeck.length;flashFlipped=false;renderFlashcard()}

function prevFlashcard(){flashIdx=(flashIdx-1+activeDeck.length)%activeDeck.length;flashFlipped=false;renderFlashcard()}

function shuffleFlashcards(){activeDeck.sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);flashIdx=0;flashFlipped=false;renderFlashcard()}

 

/* GAMES */

let sprintTimer=null,sprintScore=0,sprintAnswer=0,cIdx=0,gIdx=0;

function startMathSprint(){

  clearInterval(sprintTimer);sprintScore=0;let tl=30;const box=document.getElementById("mathGameBox"),out=document.getElementById("gameout");out.textContent="";

  function nextSum(){const a=Math.floor(Math.random()*14)+3,b=Math.floor(Math.random()*12)+2,ops=["+","-","×"],op=ops[Math.floor(Math.random()*ops.length)];sprintAnswer=op==="+"?a+b:op==="-"?a-b:a*b;box.innerHTML=`<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:8px"><span class="tag amber">⏳ ${tl}s</span><span class="tag mint">Score: ${sprintScore}</span></div><h2 style="margin:8px 0">${a} ${op} ${b} = ?</h2><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="sprintAnsInput" type="number" class="field" style="margin:0" placeholder="Answer"><button class="action" style="margin:0" onclick="checkSprintAns()">Go</button></div>`;document.getElementById("sprintAnsInput")?.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")checkSprintAns()})}

  window.checkSprintAns=function(){const v=Number(document.getElementById("sprintAnsInput")?.value);if(v===sprintAnswer){sprintScore+=10;out.textContent="Nice! +10 pts ⚡"}else{out.textContent=`Answer was ${sprintAnswer}`}nextSum()};

  nextSum();sprintTimer=setInterval(()=>{tl--;const tg=box.querySelector(".tag.amber");if(tg)tg.textContent=`⏳ ${tl}s`;if(tl<=0){clearInterval(sprintTimer);box.innerHTML=`<p><b>Time's Up!</b> Score: <b>${sprintScore} XP</b> 🎉</p><button class="action" onclick="startMathSprint()">Play Again</button>`}},1000);

}

const conceptPairs=[{q:"Ohm's Law (V = IR)",o:["Physics","Biology","History"],a:0},{q:"Mendel's Law of Segregation",o:["Chemistry","Biology","Economics"],a:1},{q:"QuickSort Algorithm",o:["Computer Science","Geography","Polity"],a:0},{q:"Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility",o:["Physics","Economics","Chemistry"],a:1}];

function startConceptGame(){const box=document.getElementById("conceptGameBox"),it=conceptPairs[cIdx%conceptPairs.length];box.innerHTML=`<p style="font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 8px">Which subject: "${it.q}"?</p>${it.o.map((o,i)=>`<button class="quizopt" onclick="checkConcept(${i})">${o}</button>`).join("")}<p id="conceptFeedback" class="sub"></p>`}

function checkConcept(i){const it=conceptPairs[cIdx%conceptPairs.length];document.getElementById("conceptFeedback").textContent=i===it.a?"Spot on! ✓":`Correct: ${it.o[it.a]}`;cIdx++;setTimeout(startConceptGame,1000)}

const gkItems=[{q:"Father of the Indian Constitution?",o:["Mahatma Gandhi","Dr. B.R. Ambedkar","Sardar Patel"],a:1},{q:"Red Planet of our Solar System?",o:["Venus","Mars","Jupiter"],a:1},{q:"HTTP stands for?",o:["HyperText Transfer Protocol","High Tech Text Process","Hyper Terminal Path"],a:0}];

function startGKGame(){const box=document.getElementById("gkGameBox"),it=gkItems[gIdx%gkItems.length];box.innerHTML=`<p style="font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 8px">${it.q}</p>${it.o.map((o,i)=>`<button class="quizopt" onclick="checkGK(${i})">${o}</button>`).join("")}<p id="gkFeedback" class="sub"></p>`}

function checkGK(i){const it=gkItems[gIdx%gkItems.length];document.getElementById("gkFeedback").textContent=i===it.a?"Correct! 🌟":`Answer: ${it.o[it.a]}`;gIdx++;setTimeout(startGKGame,1000)}

 

let cachedMaterials=[];

async function loadStudentMaterialsPortal(){

  const box=document.getElementById("studentMaterialsPortalList");if(!box||typeof db==="undefined")return;

  box.innerHTML=`<p class="muted">Loading published study materials...</p>`;

  const {data,error}=await db.from("study_materials").select("*").eq("is_active",true).order("id",{ascending:false});

  if(error){box.innerHTML=`<p class="muted">Error: ${error.message}</p>`;return}

  cachedMaterials=data||[];renderStudentMaterialsList(cachedMaterials);

}

function filterLoadedMaterials(){const q=(document.getElementById("materialSearchInput")?.value||"").trim().toLowerCase();renderStudentMaterialsList(cachedMaterials.filter(m=>(m.title||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||(m.subject||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)||(m.chapter||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)))}

function renderStudentMaterialsList(items){

  const box=document.getElementById("studentMaterialsPortalList");

  if(!items||!items.length){box.innerHTML=`<p class="muted">No matching study materials found yet.</p>`;return}

  box.innerHTML=`<div class="grid three">`+items.map(m=>`<div class="card"><div class="row"><span class="tag">${m.subject||"Study"}</span><span class="tag ${m.access_level==="premium"?"amber":"mint"}">${(m.access_level||"free").toUpperCase()}</span></div><h4 style="margin:10px 0 4px">${m.title}</h4><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 6px">Class ${m.class_level||"All"} · ${m.chapter||"General"}</p><p class="muted" style="margin:0 0 12px">${m.description||"Chapter notes and revision PDF."}</p><a href="${m.file_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="action">📖 Open Material ↗</a></div>`).join("")+`</div>`;

}

function syncProgressPage(){

  const acc=document.getElementById("dashboardAccuracy")?.textContent||"—";

  document.getElementById("progressAccuracyView").textContent=acc;

  document.getElementById("progressAccuracyBar").style.width=(parseInt(acc,10)||0)+"%";

  document.getElementById("progressXPView").textContent=(document.getElementById("dashboardXP")?.textContent||"0")+" XP";

  document.getElementById("progressStreakView").textContent=(document.getElementById("studyStreak")?.textContent||"0 Days")+" 🔥";

}

 

document.getElementById("lang").addEventListener("change",e=>notify(e.target.value==="hi"?"हिंदी माध्यम वरीयता चुनी गई है।":"English interface selected."));

renderTrackCards();renderQ();updateQuizStats();loadStudyGoals();loadFlashcardDeck();

document.getElementById("quickScratchpad").value=localStorage.getItem("sv_scratchpad")||"";

document.getElementById("todayFocusSessions").textContent=localStorage.getItem("sv_sessions_today")||"0";

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>

<script>

const SUPABASE_URL = "https://cvdfwlijbytnnfciyetf.supabase.co";

const SUPABASE_KEY = "sb_publishable_QGH0bqlmT3OR5xNmaoNIaw_VJ5DKCMT";

 

const db = window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);

const message = document.getElementById("authMessage");

 

function applyProfileToUI(profile, fallbackEmail) {

  const name = profile?.full_name || (fallbackEmail ? fallbackEmail.split("@")[0] : "Student");

  const cls = profile?.class_level || "Not selected";

  const exam = profile?.exam_target || "Not selected";

  const membership = (profile?.membership || "free").toUpperCase();

  document.getElementById("studentName").textContent = name;

  document.getElementById("studentClass").textContent = "Class " + cls;

  document.getElementById("studentAvatar").textContent = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  document.getElementById("profilePageName").textContent = name;

  document.getElementById("profilePageClass").textContent = "Class " + cls;

  document.getElementById("profileExam").textContent = exam;

  document.getElementById("profileMembership").textContent = membership;

  const openBtn = document.getElementById("openAuthBtn");

  if (openBtn) openBtn.textContent = "Account";

}

 

async function initAuthSession() {

  try {

    const { data: { session } } = await db.auth.getSession();

    if (session && session.user) {

      const { data: profile } = await db.from("profiles").select("full_name, class_level, exam_target, membership").eq("id", session.user.id).maybeSingle();

      applyProfileToUI(profile, session.user.email);

      document.getElementById("logoutBtn").style.display = "block";

      document.getElementById("authBox").style.display = "none";

      await checkAdminAccess();

      await loadDashboardXP();

      await updateDashboardStats();

    } else {

      document.getElementById("authBox").style.display = "block";

    }

  } catch (e) { console.error("Session init:", e); }

}

 

document.getElementById("signupBtn").onclick = async () => {

  const fullName = document.getElementById("fullName").value.trim();

  const email = document.getElementById("email").value.trim();

  const password = document.getElementById("password").value;

  const classLevel = document.getElementById("classLevel").value;

  const examTarget = document.getElementById("examTarget").value;

  if (!fullName || !email || password.length < 8) {

    message.textContent = "Name, email and password (8+ characters) required.";

    return;

  }

  message.textContent = "Creating account...";

  const { data, error } = await db.auth.signUp({

    email, password,

    options: { data: { full_name: fullName, class_level: classLevel, exam_target: examTarget } }

  });

  if (error) { message.textContent = error.message; return; }

  message.textContent = data.session ? "Account created! You are logged in." : "Account created! Please confirm your email, then log in.";

};

 

document.getElementById("loginBtn").onclick = async () => {

  const email = document.getElementById("email").value.trim();

  const password = document.getElementById("password").value;

  message.textContent = "Logging in...";

  const { data, error } = await db.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });

  if (error) { message.textContent = error.message; return; }

  const user = data.user;

  const meta = user.user_metadata || {};

  const { error: profileError } = await db.from("profiles").upsert({

    id: user.id,

    full_name: meta.full_name || user.email.split("@")[0],

    class_level: meta.class_level || null,

    exam_target: meta.exam_target || null

  }, { onConflict: "id" });

  if (profileError) { message.textContent = "Profile Error: " + profileError.message; return; }

  const { data: profile, error: fetchError } = await db.from("profiles").select("full_name, class_level, exam_target, membership").eq("id", user.id).single();

  if (fetchError) { message.textContent = "Profile Load Error: " + fetchError.message; return; }

  applyProfileToUI(profile, user.email);

  await checkAdminAccess();

  await loadDashboardXP();

  await updateDashboardStats();

  document.getElementById("logoutBtn").style.display = "block";

  message.textContent = "Welcome to STUDYVERSE!";

  document.getElementById("authBox").style.display = "none";

};

 

async function editProfile() {

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { alert("Please login first."); return; }

  const newName = prompt("Enter your full name:"); if (newName === null) return;

  const newClass = prompt("Enter your class (e.g. 12):"); if (newClass === null) return;

  const newExam = prompt("Enter your exam target (e.g. JEE):"); if (newExam === null) return;

  const { error } = await db.from("profiles").update({

    full_name: newName.trim(), class_level: newClass.trim(), exam_target: newExam.trim()

  }).eq("id", user.id);

  if (error) { alert("Update Error: " + error.message); return; }

  document.getElementById("profilePageName").textContent = newName;

  document.getElementById("profilePageClass").textContent = "Class " + newClass;

  document.getElementById("profileExam").textContent = newExam;

  document.getElementById("studentName").textContent = newName;

  document.getElementById("studentClass").textContent = "Class " + newClass;

  document.getElementById("studentAvatar").textContent = newName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  alert("Profile updated successfully!");

}

 

async function checkAdminAccess() {

  const { data: { user } } = await db.auth.getUser();

  const adminButton = document.getElementById("adminNavBtn");

  if (!adminButton) return;

  if (!user) { adminButton.style.display = "none"; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("admin_users").select("user_id").eq("user_id", user.id).maybeSingle();

  if (error) { console.error("Admin check error:", error.message); adminButton.style.display = "none"; return; }

  adminButton.style.display = data ? "flex" : "none";

  if (data) { loadAdminQuestions(); loadAdminMotivation(); }

}

 

async function logout() {

  const { error } = await db.auth.signOut();

  if (error) { alert("Logout Error: " + error.message); return; }

  document.getElementById("adminNavBtn").style.display = "none";

  document.getElementById("logoutBtn").style.display = "none";

  document.getElementById("openAuthBtn").textContent = "Login / Sign Up";

  document.getElementById("authBox").style.display = "block";

  alert("Logged out successfully!");

}

 

async function loadLeaderboard() {

  const list = document.getElementById("leaderboardList");

  if (!list) return;

  const { data, error } = await db.rpc("get_student_leaderboard");

  if (error) { list.textContent = "Leaderboard loading error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No quiz records yet."; return; }

  list.innerHTML = data.map(student => `

    <div class="rank">

      <div class="ranknum">${student.rank}</div>

      <div class="rankname"><b>Student ${student.rank}</b><small>${student.total_correct} correct · ${student.accuracy}% accuracy</small></div>

      <div class="score">${student.total_attempted} attempts</div>

    </div>

  `).join("");

}

 

async function addQuizQuestion() {

  const msg = document.getElementById("quizAdminMessage");

  const question = document.getElementById("quizQuestion").value.trim();

  const optionA = document.getElementById("quizOptionA").value.trim();

  const optionB = document.getElementById("quizOptionB").value.trim();

  const optionC = document.getElementById("quizOptionC").value.trim();

  const optionD = document.getElementById("quizOptionD").value.trim();

  const correct = document.getElementById("quizCorrect").value;

  const explanation = document.getElementById("quizExplanation").value.trim();

  const classLevel = document.getElementById("quizClass").value.trim();

  const subject = document.getElementById("quizSubject").value;

  const difficulty = document.getElementById("quizDifficulty").value;

  if (!question || !optionA || !optionB || !optionC || !optionD || !correct || !classLevel || !subject) {

    msg.textContent = "Please fill all required fields."; return;

  }

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Saving question...";

  const { error } = await db.from("quiz_questions").insert({

    question, option_a: optionA, option_b: optionB, option_c: optionC, option_d: optionD,

    correct_option: correct, explanation, class_level: classLevel, subject, difficulty, is_published: false

  });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Save Error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Question saved successfully!";

  ["quizQuestion","quizOptionA","quizOptionB","quizOptionC","quizOptionD","quizExplanation","quizClass"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");

  document.getElementById("quizCorrect").value = "";

  document.getElementById("quizSubject").value = "";

  document.getElementById("quizDifficulty").value = "Easy";

}

 

async function loadAdminQuestions() {

  const list = document.getElementById("adminQuestionList");

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { list.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("quiz_questions").select("*").order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { list.textContent = "Loading Error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No questions added yet."; return; }

  list.innerHTML = data.map(q => `

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:12px">

      <h4>${q.question}</h4>

      <p>A. ${q.option_a} | B. ${q.option_b} | C. ${q.option_c} | D. ${q.option_d}</p>

      <p>Correct Answer: ${q.correct_option} | Class ${q.class_level} | ${q.subject} | ${q.difficulty}</p>

      <p>Status: ${q.is_published ? "Published" : "Draft"}</p>

      <button class="action" onclick="toggleQuestionPublish(${q.id}, ${!q.is_published})">${q.is_published ? "Unpublish" : "Publish"}</button>

    </div>

  `).join("");

}

 

async function toggleQuestionPublish(id, publish) {

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { alert("Please login first."); return; }

  const { error } = await db.from("quiz_questions").update({ is_published: publish }).eq("id", id);

  if (error) { alert("Update Error: " + error.message); return; }

  await loadAdminQuestions();

}

 

async function addMotivationPost() {

  const msg = document.getElementById("motivationAdminMessage");

  const title = document.getElementById("motivationTitle").value.trim();

  const content = document.getElementById("motivationContent").value.trim();

  const language = document.getElementById("motivationLanguage").value;

  if (!title || !content) { msg.textContent = "Please enter title and content."; return; }

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Saving motivation...";

  const { error } = await db.from("motivation_posts").insert({ title, content, language, is_published: false });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Save Error: " + error.message; return; }

async function addStudyPhoto() {

  const msg = document.getElementById("photoAdminMessage");

  const title = document.getElementById("photoTitle").value.trim();

  const file = document.getElementById("photoFile").files[0];

  const description = document.getElementById("photoDescription").value.trim();

  if (!title || !file) { msg.textContent = "Please enter title and select an image."; return; }

  if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) { msg.textContent = "Please select a valid image."; return; }

  if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { msg.textContent = "Image size must be below 5 MB."; return; }

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Uploading image...";

  const safeName = file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");

  const filePath = user.id + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + safeName;

  const { error: uploadError } = await db.storage.from("studyverse-photos").upload(filePath, file);

  if (uploadError) { msg.textContent = "Upload Error: " + uploadError.message; return; }

  const { data: urlData } = db.storage.from("studyverse-photos").getPublicUrl(filePath);

  const { error } = await db.from("study_photos").insert({ title, image_url: urlData.publicUrl, description, is_published: false });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Database Error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Photo uploaded and saved successfully!";

  document.getElementById("photoTitle").value = "";

  document.getElementById("photoFile").value = "";

  document.getElementById("photoDescription").value = "";

  document.getElementById("photoPreview").style.display = "none";

  await loadAdminPhotos();

}

 

async function loadAdminPhotos() {

  const list = document.getElementById("adminPhotoList");

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No photos added yet."; return; }

  list.innerHTML = "";

  data.forEach(photo => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const img = document.createElement("img"); img.src = photo.image_url; img.alt = photo.title; img.style.width = "100%"; img.style.maxWidth = "300px"; img.style.borderRadius = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = photo.title;

    const d = document.createElement("p"); d.textContent = photo.description || "";

    const st = document.createElement("p"); st.textContent = "Status: " + (photo.is_published ? "Published" : "Draft");

    btn.onclick = () => togglePhotoPublish(photo.id, !photo.is_published);

  });

}

async function loadMembershipStudents() {

  const list = document.getElementById("adminMembershipList"), msg = document.getElementById("membershipAdminMessage");

  msg.textContent = "Loading memberships...";

  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (userError || !user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("profiles").select("id, full_name, class_level, membership").order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Loading Error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No students found."; msg.textContent = ""; return; }

  list.innerHTML = "";

  data.forEach(student => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = student.full_name || "Unnamed Student";

    const c = document.createElement("p"); c.textContent = "Class: " + (student.class_level || "Not set");

    const lbl = document.createElement("label"); lbl.textContent = "Membership: ";

    const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

    ["free", "premium"].forEach(lvl => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = lvl; o.textContent = lvl === "free" ? "Free" : "Premium"; sel.appendChild(o); });

    sel.value = (student.membership || "free").toLowerCase();

    const btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "action"; btn.textContent = "Update Membership";

    btn.onclick = async () => {

      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Updating...";

      const { error: uErr } = await db.from("profiles").update({ membership: sel.value }).eq("id", student.id);

      if (uErr) { alert("Update Error: " + uErr.message); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Update Membership"; return; }

      alert("Membership updated successfully!"); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Update Membership";

    };

    card.append(h, c, lbl, sel, btn); list.appendChild(card);

  });

  msg.textContent = "Students loaded: " + data.length;

}

 

async function loadAdminAnalytics() {

  const box = document.getElementById("adminAnalytics"); box.textContent = "Loading analytics...";

  const { data: questions, error: qErr } = await db.from("quiz_questions").select("id");

  if (qErr) { box.textContent = "Quiz Error: " + qErr.message; return; }

  const free = profiles.filter(p => (p.membership || "free").toLowerCase() === "free").length;

  const prem = profiles.filter(p => (p.membership || "free").toLowerCase() === "premium").length;

  box.innerHTML = "";

  [["👨‍🎓 Total Students", profiles.length], ["🆓 Free Members", free], ["💎 Premium Members", prem], ["📚 Total Questions", questions.length]].forEach(([l, v]) => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = l;

    const n = document.createElement("h2"); n.textContent = v;

    card.append(h, n); box.appendChild(card);

  });

}

async function loadContentAccess() {

  const list = document.getElementById("adminContentAccessList"), msg = document.getElementById("contentAccessMessage");

  list.textContent = "Loading content...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("content_access").select("*").order("id", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { list.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  list.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No content added yet."; return; }

    const inf = document.createElement("p"); inf.textContent = item.content_type + " | " + item.access_level.toUpperCase() + " | " + (item.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive");

    const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

    ["free", "premium"].forEach(l => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = l; o.textContent = l.toUpperCase(); o.selected = item.access_level === l; sel.appendChild(o); });

    const uBtn = document.createElement("button"); uBtn.className = "action"; uBtn.textContent = "Update Access";

    const aBtn = document.createElement("button"); aBtn.className = "action"; aBtn.style.marginTop = "8px"; aBtn.textContent = item.is_active ? "Deactivate Content" : "Activate Content";

    aBtn.onclick = async () => { const { error: e } = await db.from("content_access").update({ is_active: !item.is_active }).eq("id", item.id); if (e) { msg.textContent = "Error: " + e.message; return; } msg.textContent = "Content status updated!"; loadContentAccess(); };

    card.append(h, inf, sel, uBtn, aBtn); list.appendChild(card);

  });

}

async function uploadStudyPDF() {

  const file = document.getElementById("materialPdfFile").files[0], msg = document.getElementById("pdfUploadMessage"), urlInput = document.getElementById("materialUrl");

  if (!file) { msg.textContent = "Please choose a PDF file first."; return; }

  if (file.type !== "application/pdf") { msg.textContent = "Please select a PDF file only."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Uploading PDF...";

  const safeName = file.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "_");

  const { data, error } = await db.storage.from("studyverse-pdfs").upload(Date.now() + "_" + safeName, file);

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Upload failed: " + error.message; return; }

  const { data: urlData } = db.storage.from("studyverse-pdfs").getPublicUrl(data.path);

  urlInput.value = urlData.publicUrl;

  msg.textContent = "PDF uploaded successfully! URL added automatically.";

}

async function addTestQuestion() {

async function loadTestQuestions() {

  const testId = document.getElementById("questionTestSelect").value, list = document.getElementById("testQuestionList");

  list.replaceChildren();

  if (!testId) { list.textContent = "Please select a test first."; return; }

    const mk = document.createElement("p"); mk.textContent = "Marks: " + q.marks; card.appendChild(mk);

async function loadStudyAssignments() {

  });

async function loadAssignmentSubmissions() {

  const list = document.getElementById("adminSubmissionList"), msg = document.getElementById("submissionAdminMessage");

  list.replaceChildren(); msg.textContent = "Loading submissions...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_assignment_submissions").select("*").order("submitted_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "";

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No submissions found."; return; }

  for (const sub of data) {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = sub.student_name || "Student";

    const ai = document.createElement("p"); ai.textContent = "Assignment ID: " + sub.assignment_id;

    const sm = document.createElement("p"); sm.textContent = "Submitted: " + new Date(sub.submitted_at).toLocaleString();

    const ans = document.createElement("p"); ans.textContent = "Answer: " + sub.answer;

    const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

    ["Submitted", "Reviewed", "Graded"].forEach(s => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = s; o.textContent = s; if (sub.status === s) o.selected = true; sel.appendChild(o); });

    const fb = document.createElement("textarea"); fb.className = "field"; fb.value = sub.admin_feedback || ""; fb.placeholder = "Write feedback";

    const mk = document.createElement("input"); mk.className = "field"; mk.type = "number"; mk.value = sub.marks_obtained ?? ""; mk.placeholder = "Enter marks";

    const btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "action"; btn.textContent = "Save Review";

    btn.onclick = async () => {

      const mv = mk.value.trim();

      if (mv !== "" && !Number.isFinite(Number(mv))) { msg.textContent = "Please enter valid marks."; return; }

      msg.textContent = "Saving review...";

      const { error: uErr } = await db.from("study_assignment_submissions").update({ status: sel.value, admin_feedback: fb.value.trim(), marks_obtained: mv === "" ? null : Number(mv) }).eq("id", sub.id);

      if (uErr) { msg.textContent = "Save error: " + uErr.message; return; }

      msg.textContent = "Review saved successfully!";

    };

    card.append(h, ai, sm, ans, sel, fb, mk, btn); list.appendChild(card);

  }

}

async function submitStudentAssignment() {

  const assignmentId = document.getElementById("studentAssignmentSelect").value, answer = document.getElementById("studentAssignmentAnswer").value.trim(), msg = document.getElementById("studentAssignmentMessage");

  if (!assignmentId || !answer) { msg.textContent = "Select an assignment and write your answer."; return; }

  const { data: authData, error: authError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (authError || !authData.user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const user = authData.user;

  const { data: profile, error: pErr } = await db.from("profiles").select("full_name").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();

  if (pErr) { msg.textContent = "Profile error: " + pErr.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Submitting answer...";

  const { error } = await db.from("study_assignment_submissions").insert([{ assignment_id: Number(assignmentId), user_id: user.id, student_name: profile?.full_name || "", answer }]);

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Submission error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Assignment submitted successfully!"; document.getElementById("studentAssignmentAnswer").value = ""; loadMyAssignmentSubmissions();

}

 

async function loadMyAssignmentSubmissions() {

  const list = document.getElementById("myAssignmentSubmissionList"); list.replaceChildren();

  const { data: authData, error: authError } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (authError || !authData.user) { list.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_assignment_submissions").select("*").eq("user_id", authData.user.id).order("submitted_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { list.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { list.textContent = "No submissions found."; return; }

  for (const sub of data) {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = "Assignment ID: " + sub.assignment_id;

    const ans = document.createElement("p"); ans.textContent = "Your answer: " + sub.answer;

function getStudyLocalDate() {

  const d = new Date();

  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;

}

 

async function saveStudyActivity() {

  const minutes = Number(document.getElementById("studyMinutes").value), note = document.getElementById("studyNote").value.trim(), msg = document.getElementById("studyTrackerMessage");

  if (!Number.isInteger(minutes) || minutes < 0) { msg.textContent = "Please enter valid study minutes."; return; }

  const { data: { user } } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Saving...";

  const { error } = await db.from("study_activity").upsert({ user_id: user.id, activity_date: getStudyLocalDate(), study_minutes: minutes, activity_note: note }, { onConflict: "user_id,activity_date" });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Study progress saved successfully!";

  await loadStudyTracker();

}

 

async function loadStudyTracker() {

  const history = document.getElementById("studyHistoryList");

  history.textContent = "Loading study history...";

  const { data: { user } } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) { history.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_activity").select("activity_date,study_minutes,activity_note").eq("user_id", user.id).order("activity_date", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { history.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  const records = data || [], today = getStudyLocalDate(), todayRec = records.find(r => r.activity_date === today);

  document.getElementById("todayStudyTotal").textContent = (todayRec ? todayRec.study_minutes : 0) + " Minutes";

  document.getElementById("studyMinutes").value = todayRec ? todayRec.study_minutes : "";

  document.getElementById("studyNote").value = todayRec ? todayRec.activity_note || "" : "";

  document.getElementById("totalStudyMinutes").textContent = records.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r.study_minutes || 0), 0) + " Minutes";

  let streak = 0;

  if (records.length > 0) {

    const dates = new Set(records.map(r => r.activity_date)), cursor = new Date(today + "T12:00:00");

    if (!dates.has(today)) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);

    while (true) {

      const ds = `${cursor.getFullYear()}-${String(cursor.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(cursor.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;

      if (!dates.has(ds)) break;

      streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);

    }

  }

  document.getElementById("studyStreak").textContent = streak + " Days";

  history.textContent = "";

  if (records.length === 0) { history.textContent = "No study history yet."; return; }

  records.forEach(r => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "10px";

    const d = document.createElement("h4"); d.textContent = r.activity_date;

    const m = document.createElement("p"); m.textContent = r.study_minutes + " Minutes";

    const n = document.createElement("p"); n.textContent = r.activity_note || "No study note";

    card.append(d, m, n); history.appendChild(card);

  });

}
