let studentQuizQuestions = [], studentQuizIndex = 0, studentQuizScore = 0, studentQuizAnswered = false;

async function startStudentQuiz() {

  const area = document.getElementById("studentQuizArea"); area.textContent = "Loading questions...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("quiz_questions").select("question,option_a,option_b,option_c,option_d,correct_option,explanation").eq("is_published", true);

  if (error) { area.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { area.textContent = "No published questions available yet."; return; }

  studentQuizQuestions = data.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5); studentQuizIndex = 0; studentQuizScore = 0; studentQuizAnswered = false;

  renderStudentQuizQuestion();

}

 

function renderStudentQuizQuestion() {

  const area = document.getElementById("studentQuizArea"); area.textContent = "";

  if (studentQuizIndex >= studentQuizQuestions.length) { finishStudentQuiz(); return; }

  studentQuizAnswered = false;

  const q = studentQuizQuestions[studentQuizIndex];

  const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = "Question " + (studentQuizIndex + 1) + " of " + studentQuizQuestions.length;

  const p = document.createElement("p"); p.textContent = q.question;

  area.append(h, p);

  const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

  const ph = document.createElement("option"); ph.value = ""; ph.textContent = "Select an answer"; sel.appendChild(ph);

  [["A", q.option_a], ["B", q.option_b], ["C", q.option_c], ["D", q.option_d]].forEach(([l, t]) => {

    const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = l; o.textContent = l + ". " + t; sel.appendChild(o);

  });

  area.appendChild(sel);

  const subBtn = document.createElement("button"); subBtn.className = "action"; subBtn.textContent = "Submit Answer";

  const fb = document.createElement("p");

  const nextBtn = document.createElement("button"); nextBtn.className = "action"; nextBtn.textContent = studentQuizIndex === studentQuizQuestions.length - 1 ? "Finish Quiz" : "Next Question"; nextBtn.style.display = "none";

  subBtn.onclick = () => {

    if (studentQuizAnswered) return;

    const chosen = sel.value; if (!chosen) { fb.textContent = "Please select an answer."; return; }

    studentQuizAnswered = true;

    const correct = String(q.correct_option).trim().toUpperCase();

    if (chosen === correct) { studentQuizScore++; fb.textContent = "Correct answer! 🎉"; } else { fb.textContent = "Incorrect answer. Correct option: " + correct; }

    if (q.explanation) fb.textContent += " | " + q.explanation;

    sel.disabled = true; subBtn.disabled = true; nextBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";

  };

  nextBtn.onclick = () => { if (!studentQuizAnswered) return; studentQuizIndex++; renderStudentQuizQuestion(); };

  area.append(subBtn, fb, nextBtn);

}

 

async function finishStudentQuiz() {

  const area = document.getElementById("studentQuizArea"); area.textContent = "";

  const h = document.createElement("h2"); h.textContent = "Quiz Completed! 🎉";

  const r = document.createElement("p"); r.textContent = "Your Score: " + studentQuizScore + " / " + studentQuizQuestions.length;

  area.append(h, r);

  const { data: { user } } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (user) {

    const { error } = await db.from("quiz_attempts").insert({ user_id: user.id, quiz_type: "practice", total_questions: studentQuizQuestions.length, score: studentQuizScore });

    const sm = document.createElement("p"); sm.textContent = error ? "Result save error: " + error.message : "Your result has been saved!"; area.appendChild(sm);

  }

  const rs = document.createElement("button"); rs.className = "action"; rs.textContent = "Play Again"; rs.onclick = startStudentQuiz; area.appendChild(rs);

}

let activeMockTest = null, mockTestQuestions = [], mockTestIndex = 0, mockTestScore = 0, mockTestTimer = null, mockTestAttemptId = null, mockTestAnswers = [];

async function loadStudentTests() {

    const btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "action"; btn.textContent = "Start Test"; btn.onclick = () => startMockTest(test);

    card.append(h, det, btn); list.appendChild(card);

async function startMockTest(test) {

  clearInterval(mockTestTimer);

  const area = document.getElementById("studentTestAttemptArea"); area.textContent = "Loading test questions...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_test_questions").select("id,question,option_a,option_b,option_c,option_d,correct_option,explanation,marks").eq("test_id", test.id);

  if (error) { area.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { area.textContent = "No questions found in this test."; return; }

  const { data: { user } } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (!user) { area.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data: attempt, error: aErr } = await db.from("study_test_attempts").insert({ user_id: user.id, test_id: test.id, total_marks: test.total_marks || 0, status: "in_progress" }).select("id").single();

  if (aErr) { area.textContent = "Attempt error: " + aErr.message; return; }

  mockTestAttemptId = attempt.id; activeMockTest = test; mockTestQuestions = data.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5); mockTestIndex = 0; mockTestScore = 0; mockTestAnswers = [];

  renderMockTestQuestion();

  let seconds = Math.max(1, Number(test.duration_minutes || 1)) * 60;

  updateMockTestTimer(seconds);

  mockTestTimer = setInterval(() => { seconds--; updateMockTestTimer(seconds); if (seconds <= 0) { clearInterval(mockTestTimer); submitMockTest(true); } }, 1000);

}

 

function updateMockTestTimer(seconds) {

  const t = document.getElementById("mockTestTimer"); if (!t) return;

  t.textContent = "Time Left: " + Math.floor(seconds / 60) + ":" + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0");

}

 

function renderMockTestQuestion() {

  const area = document.getElementById("studentTestAttemptArea"); area.textContent = "";

  const q = mockTestQuestions[mockTestIndex]; if (!q) { submitMockTest(false); return; }

  const timer = document.createElement("h3"); timer.id = "mockTestTimer";

  const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = "Question " + (mockTestIndex + 1) + " of " + mockTestQuestions.length;

  const qp = document.createElement("p"); qp.textContent = q.question;

  const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

  const ph = document.createElement("option"); ph.value = ""; ph.textContent = "Select answer"; sel.appendChild(ph);

  [["A", q.option_a], ["B", q.option_b], ["C", q.option_c], ["D", q.option_d]].forEach(([l, v]) => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = l; o.textContent = l + ". " + v; sel.appendChild(o); });

  if (mockTestAnswers[mockTestIndex]) sel.value = mockTestAnswers[mockTestIndex];

  const prev = document.createElement("button"); prev.className = "action outline"; prev.textContent = "Previous Question"; prev.disabled = mockTestIndex === 0;

  prev.onclick = () => { mockTestAnswers[mockTestIndex] = sel.value; if (mockTestIndex > 0) { mockTestIndex--; renderMockTestQuestion(); } };

  const next = document.createElement("button"); next.className = "action"; next.textContent = mockTestIndex === mockTestQuestions.length - 1 ? "Submit Test" : "Next Question";

  next.onclick = () => { mockTestAnswers[mockTestIndex] = sel.value; if (mockTestIndex < mockTestQuestions.length - 1) { mockTestIndex++; renderMockTestQuestion(); } else submitMockTest(false); };

  area.append(timer, h, qp, sel, prev, next);

}

 

async function submitMockTest(autoSubmit) {

  if (!mockTestAttemptId) return;

  clearInterval(mockTestTimer);

  const area = document.getElementById("studentTestAttemptArea");

  if (!autoSubmit) { const cur = area.querySelector("select"); if (cur) mockTestAnswers[mockTestIndex] = cur.value; }

  mockTestScore = 0;

  mockTestQuestions.forEach((q, i) => { if (mockTestAnswers[i] === String(q.correct_option).trim().toUpperCase()) mockTestScore += Number(q.marks || 0); });

  const { error } = await db.from("study_test_attempts").update({ score: mockTestScore, submitted_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: "submitted" }).eq("id", mockTestAttemptId);

  area.textContent = "";

  const h = document.createElement("h2"); h.textContent = "Test Submitted!";

  const r = document.createElement("p"); r.textContent = "Score: " + mockTestScore + " / " + (activeMockTest.total_marks || 0);

  const m = document.createElement("p"); m.textContent = error ? "Result update error: " + error.message : autoSubmit ? "Time ended. Your test was submitted." : "Your test has been submitted successfully.";

  area.append(h, r, m); mockTestAttemptId = null;

}

}

 

async function toggleVideoLecturePublish(id, publish) {

  const { error } = await db.from("study_video_lectures").update({ is_published: publish }).eq("id", id);

  if (error) { alert("Update error: " + error.message); return; }

  await loadAdminVideoLectures();

}

 

async function loadStudentVideoLectures() {

  const c = document.getElementById("studentVideoLectureList"); c.textContent = "Loading video lectures...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_video_lectures").select("id,title,subject,class_level,chapter,description,video_url,access_level").eq("is_published", true).order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { c.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  c.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { c.textContent = "No published video lectures available."; return; }

  data.forEach(v => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = v.title || "Video Lecture";

    const d = document.createElement("p"); d.className = "muted"; d.textContent = (v.subject || "N/A") + " | Class " + (v.class_level || "N/A") + " | " + (v.chapter || "N/A");

    const desc = document.createElement("p"); desc.textContent = v.description || "No description available.";

    const acc = document.createElement("p"); acc.className = "muted"; acc.textContent = "Access: " + v.access_level.toUpperCase();

    const btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "action"; btn.textContent = "Watch Lecture";

    btn.onclick = () => {

      try {

        const u = new URL(v.video_url);

        if (u.protocol !== "https:" || !["youtube.com","www.youtube.com","youtu.be","m.youtube.com"].includes(u.hostname)) { alert("Please use a valid HTTPS YouTube link."); return; }

        window.open(u.href, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");

      } catch { alert("Invalid video link."); }

    };

    card.append(h, d, desc, acc, btn); c.appendChild(card);

  });

}

 

async function loadAdminDoubts() {

  const c = document.getElementById("adminDoubtList"), msg = document.getElementById("doubtAdminMessage");

  c.textContent = "Loading student doubts..."; msg.textContent = "";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_doubts").select("*").order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { c.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  c.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { c.textContent = "No student doubts found."; return; }

  data.forEach(doubt => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = doubt.student_name || "Student";

    const det = document.createElement("p"); det.className = "muted"; det.textContent = (doubt.subject || "Subject") + " | Class " + (doubt.class_level || "N/A") + " | " + (doubt.chapter || "N/A");

    const q = document.createElement("p"); q.textContent = doubt.doubt_message;

    const reply = document.createElement("textarea"); reply.className = "field"; reply.value = doubt.admin_reply || ""; reply.placeholder = "Write your reply here...";

    const sel = document.createElement("select"); sel.className = "field";

    ["Pending", "Answered", "Resolved"].forEach(v => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v; o.textContent = v; sel.appendChild(o); });

    sel.value = doubt.status || "Pending";

    const btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "action"; btn.textContent = "Save Reply & Status";

    btn.onclick = async () => {

      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Saving...";

      const { error: uErr } = await db.from("study_doubts").update({ admin_reply: reply.value.trim(), status: sel.value }).eq("id", doubt.id);

      if (uErr) { msg.textContent = "Save error: " + uErr.message; btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Save Reply & Status"; return; }

      msg.textContent = "Reply and status saved."; await loadAdminDoubts();

    };

    card.append(h, det, q, reply, sel, btn); c.appendChild(card);

  });

}

 

async function submitStudentDoubt() {

  const subject = document.getElementById("studentDoubtSubject").value.trim(), classLevel = document.getElementById("studentDoubtClass").value.trim(), chapter = document.getElementById("studentDoubtChapter").value.trim(), doubtMessage = document.getElementById("studentDoubtMessage").value.trim(), msg = document.getElementById("studentDoubtMessageStatus");

  if (!subject || !doubtMessage) { msg.textContent = "Subject and doubt message are required."; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Submitting doubt...";

  const { data: userData, error: uErr } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (uErr || !userData.user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data: profile } = await db.from("profiles").select("full_name").eq("id", userData.user.id).maybeSingle();

  const { error } = await db.from("study_doubts").insert([{ user_id: userData.user.id, student_name: profile?.full_name || "Student", subject, class_level: classLevel, chapter, doubt_message: doubtMessage }]);

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Submission error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Doubt submitted successfully!";

  ["studentDoubtSubject","studentDoubtClass","studentDoubtChapter","studentDoubtMessage"].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = "");

  await loadMyDoubts();

}

 

async function loadMyDoubts() {

  const c = document.getElementById("myDoubtList"); c.textContent = "Loading your doubts...";

  const { data: userData, error: uErr } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (uErr || !userData.user) { c.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_doubts").select("subject,class_level,chapter,doubt_message,admin_reply,status,created_at").eq("user_id", userData.user.id).order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { c.textContent = "Loading error: " + error.message; return; }

  c.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { c.textContent = "You have not submitted any doubts yet."; return; }

  data.forEach(d => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = d.subject || "Subject";

    const det = document.createElement("p"); det.className = "muted"; det.textContent = "Class " + (d.class_level || "N/A") + " | " + (d.chapter || "N/A");

    const q = document.createElement("p"); q.textContent = "Your Doubt: " + d.doubt_message;

    const st = document.createElement("p"); st.textContent = "Status: " + (d.status || "Pending");

    const rp = document.createElement("p"); rp.textContent = "Admin Reply: " + (d.admin_reply || "Awaiting reply");

    card.append(h, det, q, st, rp); c.appendChild(card);

  });

}

 

async function saveStudentReward() {

  const userId = document.getElementById("rewardStudentId").value.trim(), xp = Number(document.getElementById("rewardXP").value), level = Number(document.getElementById("rewardLevel").value), badgeText = document.getElementById("rewardBadges").value.trim(), msg = document.getElementById("rewardAdminMessage");

  if (!userId || !Number.isInteger(xp) || !Number.isInteger(level) || xp < 0 || level < 1) { msg.textContent = "Enter valid Student ID, XP (>=0) and Level (>=1)."; return; }

  const badges = badgeText ? badgeText.split(",").map(b => b.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

  msg.textContent = "Saving rewards...";

  const { error } = await db.from("study_rewards").upsert({ user_id: userId, xp_points: xp, level, badges, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: "user_id" });

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Save error: " + error.message; return; }

  msg.textContent = "Rewards saved successfully!"; await loadAdminRewards();

}

 

async function loadAdminRewards() {

  const c = document.getElementById("adminRewardList"); c.textContent = "Loading rewards...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_rewards").select("user_id,xp_points,level,badges,updated_at").order("xp_points", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { c.textContent = "Loading error: " + error.message; return; }

  c.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { c.textContent = "No rewards records found."; return; }

  data.forEach(r => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h4"); h.textContent = "Student ID: " + r.user_id;

    const xp = document.createElement("p"); xp.textContent = "XP: " + r.xp_points + " | Level: " + r.level;

    const bg = document.createElement("p"); bg.textContent = "Badges: " + (Array.isArray(r.badges) && r.badges.length ? r.badges.join(", ") : "None");

    card.append(h, xp, bg); c.appendChild(card);

  });

}

 

async function loadMyRewards() {

  const xpEl = document.getElementById("myRewardXP"), lvEl = document.getElementById("myRewardLevel"), bcEl = document.getElementById("myRewardBadgeCount"), bcBox = document.getElementById("myRewardBadgesList"), msg = document.getElementById("myRewardMessage");

  msg.textContent = "Loading rewards...";

  const { data: userData, error: uErr } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (uErr || !userData.user) { msg.textContent = "Please login first."; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_rewards").select("xp_points,level,badges").eq("user_id", userData.user.id).maybeSingle();

  if (error) { msg.textContent = "Loading error: " + error.message; return; }

  if (!data) { xpEl.textContent = "0 XP"; lvEl.textContent = "Level 1"; bcEl.textContent = "0"; bcBox.textContent = "No badges earned yet."; msg.textContent = "Start learning to earn rewards!"; return; }

  xpEl.textContent = (data.xp_points || 0) + " XP"; lvEl.textContent = "Level " + (data.level || 1);

  const badges = Array.isArray(data.badges) ? data.badges : [];

  bcEl.textContent = badges.length; bcBox.replaceChildren();

  if (!badges.length) bcBox.textContent = "No badges earned yet.";

  else badges.forEach(b => { const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "card"; d.style.marginTop = "10px"; d.textContent = "🏅 " + b; bcBox.appendChild(d); });

  msg.textContent = "Rewards loaded successfully!";

}

 

async function loadStudentNotifications() {

  const c = document.getElementById("studentNotificationList"); if (!c) return;

  c.textContent = "Loading notifications...";

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_notifications").select("*").eq("is_published", true).order("created_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) { c.textContent = "Error: " + error.message; return; }

  c.replaceChildren();

  if (!data || data.length === 0) { c.textContent = "No notifications available."; return; }

  data.forEach(n => {

    const card = document.createElement("div"); card.className = "card"; card.style.marginTop = "12px";

    const h = document.createElement("h3"); h.textContent = "🔔 " + (n.title || "Notification");

    const m = document.createElement("p"); m.textContent = n.message || "";

    const meta = document.createElement("p"); meta.className = "muted"; meta.textContent = "Language: " + (n.language || "Hindi") + (n.created_at ? " | " + new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString() : "");

    card.append(h, m, meta); c.appendChild(card);

  });

}

 

async function loadDashboardXP() {

  const el = document.getElementById("dashboardXP"); if (!el) return;

  const { data: { user }, error: uErr } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (uErr || !user) { el.textContent = "0"; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("study_rewards").select("xp_points").eq("user_id", user.id).maybeSingle();

  el.textContent = (!error && data) ? data.xp_points : "0";

}

 

async function updateDashboardStats() {

  const qEl = document.getElementById("dashboardQuizCount"), aEl = document.getElementById("dashboardAccuracy");

  if (!qEl || !aEl) return;

  const { data: userData, error: uErr } = await db.auth.getUser();

  if (uErr || !userData.user) { qEl.textContent = "0"; aEl.textContent = "—"; return; }

  const { data, error } = await db.from("quiz_attempts").select("is_correct").eq("user_id", userData.user.id);

  if (error) return;

  const attempts = data || [], total = attempts.length, correct = attempts.filter(x => x.is_correct === true).length;

  qEl.textContent = total;

  aEl.textContent = total ? Math.round((correct / total) * 100) + "%" : "—";

}

 

initAuthSession();

loadLeaderboard();

loadTestSelect();

</script>
